title: Rex and the Moon That Had No Smells
synopsis: Rex discovers he cannot sniff outside a helmet as the suited friends make their first careful visit onto the Moon.
continuity_state: Before: The lander has touched down, but suits and surface conditions have not yet been approved for a Moon walk. After: All six complete a short planned walk and return to the sealed lander. Footprints stay outside; the Moon equipment is not yet deployed by the crew.
